summary: High Court issued a conditional/interim order requiring the government to justify the Police Ordinance amendment expanding the national security minister's police-policy powers.
notes: Renewed June backfill adds the June 1 attorney-general position warning of politicization/civil-rights risks and the June 7 High Court hearing before the June 18 conditional order. These are procedural/legal stages of the same Police Ordinance Amendment No. 37 challenge already tracked through final disposition in LEAD-2022-0004; they do not justify a duplicate event or a broader personal-misconduct finding. Broader Netanyahu/Smotrich/Comptroller/Knesset lanes were re-searched and produced no separate qualifying June event in this pass.
